Package gui

Class MyOrdersController

java.lang.Object
gui.MyOrdersController
public class MyOrdersController extends Object
controller for the visitor's My Orders screen (MyOrdersFrame.fxml).

shows all orders for the logged-in visitor with colour-coded status cells. the cancel button is only enabled for PENDING or CONFIRMED orders. after cancellation, shows a popup if a waiting-list visitor was notified.

    • handleCancelOrder

      public void handleCancelOrder(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      confirms with the user, cancels the selected order, and notifies if a waiting-list spot was freed. reloads the table on success.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleLeaveWaitlist

      private void handleLeaveWaitlist(logic.OrderDetail selected)
      confirms with the user, then removes a still-waiting waiting-list entry ("leave the queue"). unlike cancelling a real order this frees no slot, so no waiting-list promotion is triggered server-side. reloads the table on success.
      Parameters:
      selected - the WAITING entry the visitor chose to leave

    • handleConfirmVisit

      public void handleConfirmVisit(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      confirms a tomorrow's booking so the server's auto-cancel skips it. enabled only when the selected order is PENDING/CONFIRMED with visit date = tomorrow.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleShowQR

      public void handleShowQR(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      shows the QR entry pass for the selected order. the visitor presents this code to the employee at the gate.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleClose

      public void handleClose(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Parameters:

    • enterCancelMode

      private void enterCancelMode()
      switches the already-loaded screen into cancel-focused mode: filters the table to only cancellable bookings, shows a guiding banner, and pre-selects the first row. called by start(Stage, boolean) after the FXML controller has initialised.

    • applyModeButtons

      private void applyModeButtons()
      shows exactly the one action button that matches the current mode and hides the rest: view-only "My Reservations" exposes only "Show QR Code"; cancel mode exposes only "Cancel Selected Order". "Confirm My Visit" is never shown here — it has its own tile on the visitor dashboard.

    • start
